app.title: Tarikh – Islamic History
common.error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
ai.notice: The daily story is written with the help of AI and then checked. When in doubt, verify with scholarly sources.
ai.about: Daily stories are generated by artificial intelligence and then go through an automatic fact check. They may contain mistakes: always verify with scholarly sources. Hadiths, duas and adhkar are never AI-generated: they come from recognised collections and are quoted with their reference.
about.sources: Text sources: Qur'an, Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan, Hisn al-Muslim. Prayer times are computed on the device.
fast.forbidden: Day of celebration: fasting is not permitted today.
prayer.title: Prayer times
prayer.needLocation: Choose your city to see prayer times. They are computed on your device, even offline.
location.title: Your city
location.denied: Location unavailable. Search for your city below.
location.privacy: Your location is only used to compute prayer times and the Qibla. It stays on your device.
reminder.label: Reminder of the day
story.label: Story of the day
story.noSpeech: Audio reading is not available on this device.
story.offline: Offline: here is the last saved story.
story.unavailable: The story of the day could not be loaded.
tools.title: Tools
qibla.needLocation: Set your city to compute the Qibla direction.
qibla.static: The golden arrow shows the Qibla relative to north. Turn on the compass to orient yourself.
qibla.calibrate: Hold the phone flat and move it in a figure 8 to calibrate.
qibla.turn: Turn until the arrow points up.
qibla.noSensor: Compass unavailable on this device. Use the angle shown with a compass.
qibla.help: Keep away from metal objects and magnets. The angle is measured from true north.
names.intro: The 99 most beautiful Names of Allah, following the most widespread list.
deeds.intro: Every useful action in the app counts: reading the story, praying on time, dhikr… Add your own good deeds of the day too. This counter is a personal encouragement: the reward belongs to Allah.
zakat.intro: Estimate your yearly zakat. Enter amounts in your own currency.
zakat.hawl: I have held this amount for one lunar year (hawl)
zakat.f.price: Current price per gram (gold or silver)
zakat.needPrice: Enter the price per gram to compute the nisab.
zakat.due: Your assets reach the nisab: zakat is due.
zakat.below: Your assets are below the nisab: zakat is not due.
zakat.noHawl: The lunar year has not passed: zakat is not due yet.
zakat.disclaimer: Indicative calculation. Rules vary with situations and schools: ask a scholar you trust.
ptrack.help: Tap a day to fill it in. Green: 5 prayers. Gold: partial day.
ftrack.help: Tap each day you fasted. Missed days appear under "to make up".
ramadan.lastTen: The last ten nights: seek Laylat al-Qadr.
ramadan.note: Estimated date from the Umm al-Qura calendar. The actual start depends on the moon sighting in your country.
ramadan.tip1: Make up the days missed last Ramadan.
ramadan.tip2: Get used to fasting on Mondays and Thursdays.
cal.ordinary: No particular event on this day.
cal.locked: The full explanation of this day (history, recommendations, sources) is for subscribers.
cal.note: Umm al-Qura calendar. Dates may differ by a day depending on the moon sighting: adjust them in Settings.
premium.title: Tarikh Premium
premium.subtitle: Go further: the stories of the prophets, the pilgrim's guide, the quiz and the full archive.
premium.f.prophets.d: Their full stories with Qur'an references.
premium.f.history.d: Find every story published so far.
premium.f.calendar.d: The full explanation of each special day.
premium.thenRenews: Free trial for new subscribers, then {price} per month. Renews automatically, cancel anytime.
premium.renews: {price} per month. Renews automatically, cancel anytime.
premium.error: The purchase did not go through. You have not been charged. Please try again.
premium.unavailable: Purchases are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
premium.loginFirst: Sign in with your email first so the subscription is attached to your account.
premium.legal.ios: Monthly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase (at the end of the free trial, if any). The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
premium.legal.web: Monthly auto-renewing subscription, paid by card through Stripe. Cancel anytime from your subscriber area.
premium.locked: This section is for Premium subscribers.
prophets.locked: Unlock all 25 stories of the prophets with Premium.
hajj.intro: A step-by-step guide to prepare and perform Umrah and Hajj.
hajj.locked: Unlock the full guide with Premium.
history.empty: The stories you read will appear here.
history.locked: Free version: last 3 stories. Unlock the full archive with Premium.
settings.title: Settings
settings.hijriHelp: Shift by a day or two if the date does not match your country's official announcement.
settings.dataHelp: Your counters, trackers and settings are stored on this device only.
settings.eraseConfirm: Erase all your counters, trackers and settings on this device? This cannot be undone.
notif.title: Notifications
notif.help: Get each prayer time and the story of the day. Prayer reminders are computed on your device.
notif.denied: Notifications are off. Allow them in Settings > Tarikh > Notifications.
notif.needLocation: Choose your city to receive prayer reminders.
notif.webOnly: Notifications are available in the iOS app.
notif.dailyTitle: Your story of the day is here
notif.dailyBody: A new page of Islamic history is waiting for you.
notif.fastBody: Remember to make the intention and prepare suhur.
account.title: Account (optional)
account.why: Tarikh works without an account. Sign in only to use your subscription on both web and iPhone.
account.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now.
account.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete your account, synced favourites and data? A card subscription will be cancelled.
account.deleteNote: Deletion is immediate and permanent. A subscription bought through Apple must be cancelled in Settings > your name > Subscriptions: we cannot cancel it for you.
ob.1.title: Islamic history, every day
ob.1.text: Every day: a true story, an authentic hadith and tools for your practice. Choose your language.
ob.2.title: Your prayer times
ob.2.text: Set your city: prayer times and the Qibla are computed on your device, even offline.
ob.3.title: Never miss a day
ob.3.text: Get each prayer time and the story of the day. You can adjust everything in Settings.
ob.3.textWeb: Come back every day for a new story. Add Tarikh to your home screen to open it in one tap.
